invariants: The context carries trait OBJECTS (&dyn port): the host substitutes any implementation of the three ports without touching the service (the plug-and-play rule).
admission_open is host-controlled readiness: the host sets it true only after the registry froze and the ports are ready; the admission policy reads it, nothing else writes it.
responsibilities: WorkResponse: the response sum every handler returns - one variant per port return shape.
WorkContext: the per-dispatch context the host builds - the three ports, the frozen catalog, and the admission_open readiness flag.
summary: The bridge's response sum and the host-built dispatch context (ports + frozen catalog + readiness).
